SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SPECIAL REGISTRATION
Vol. S. B. D. 1914.
Date January 9, 1931.
/5 - 1 - 31

Subject (in full) M.P. Hubinsky.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by Whouncan N.C.J.

Sir,

Information has been received that M.P. Hubinsky,
a suspected Soviet Agent, recently arrived in Shanghai
from Harbin where it is reported he was employed at the C.E.R.
and also worked as an agent of the G.P.U. He participated
in the organization of a plot to murder General Saharoff,
a well known Russian White Leader.

Hubinsky purchased for $3,000 a house at 622
Rue Lafayette where he resides. He is known to have visited
Mr. Levin, Manager of the local branch of "Centrosojus"
and Mrs. C.I. Ismailoff, wife of the former Director of
C.E.R. and member of "Comintern."

G. Tcheremshansky
D. S.

D. C. (C. & S. Branches)

Reg. Please file. Copies have
been detached / the usual
authorities.

10/1/31

（左侧批注：* See no. 9057.）
（文中涂改处文字：is alleged to have）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

档案编号
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别登记册
卷号 S. B. D. 1914。
日期 1931年1月9日。
/5 - 1 - 31

事由（全称） M.P. Hubinsky。

由 D.S. Tcheremshansky 编制。由 Whouncan N.C.J. 转呈。

先生，

接获情报称，M.P. Hubinsky，一名涉嫌的苏联特工，最近从哈尔滨抵达上海，据报他曾在中东铁路（C.E.R.）任职，并曾作为国家政治保卫总局（G.P.U.）的特工工作。他参与了策划谋杀著名的俄国白俄领袖萨哈罗夫将军（General Saharoff）的阴谋。

Hubinsky 以 3,000 美元的价格购买了霞飞路（Rue Lafayette）622 号的一处房产并居住于此。已知他曾拜访过“中央消费合作总社”（Centrosojus）本地分支经理 Levin 先生，以及前中东铁路总监、共产国际（Comintern）成员 Ismailoff 先生的妻子 C.I. Ismailoff 女士。

G. Tcheremshansky
D. S.

D. C. （刑事与特务科）

登记。请归档。副本已分送 / 各常规主管当局。

1931年1月10日

（左侧批注：* 参见第 9057 号。）
（文中涂改处文字：据称）
